question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Either __you and my__ sister is involved in this crime.
solution:
The correct answer is **"you or my"**.

• In the given options, "**you or my**" can improve the given part of sentence.
